role: Workflow Training and Change Management Specialist
headline: Clinical Training and Adoption Specialist | EMR Workflows | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health designing and delivering EHR training and helping practices adopt new workflows. I documented current and preferred clinical workflows for close to 200 client practices, configured practice-specific workflows, and trained 200+ end users, from providers to medical assistants. Earlier, as an occupational health physician, I trained 500+ people and wrote SOPs, and as an ICU registrar I trained nurses during COVID. I bring clinical credibility and training craft to adoption work.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, setup and adoption.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points, business processes and goals, then designed and configured practice-specific workflows and widgets.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on the new workflows.
Turned recurring client pain points into feature requests and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: change management, clinical workflow documentation, adoption pathways, stakeholder management, consulting
training design and delivery, end-user training, SOP writing
EMR proficiency, clinical documentation, emergency, ICU and inpatient care
thesis_html: Clinicians resist change for good reasons. I train with those in mind.
why_fit: Plus 500+ in occupational health and 12+ ICU nurses.
Documented workflows for close to 200 client practices and designed for adoption.
I know why clinicians push back, and what earns their time.
